spec.statement:
INSERT INTO bayno_assignment_history
SELECT COALESCE(file_id, '') AS file_id,
          COALESCE(line_number, '') AS line_number, source_file, source_system, feed_type,
          file_sequence, record_type, carrier, flight_number, first_leg_dep_date,
          scheduled_dep_time, departure_airport, bay_number
FROM (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY file_id, line_number ORDER BY source_file ASC
    ) AS rn
    FROM bayno_details
    WHERE file_id IS NOT NULL AND line_number IS NOT NULL
)
WHERE rn = 1;
